changes: Open/reuse local v3 lifecycle scope before the first Git precondition. All block Git calls route through managed_check_output.
Reuse inherited registry and policy lock; v3 observe receives lifecycle and does not double-remember observations.
Direct flow/renderer commands use identity-ready registry.launch+register(handle); recorded creation identity comes from the lease rather than a racy PID reread.
Database cleanup uses registry.run. Process/database/terminal-sample/registry failures are accumulated independently; the existing monitor is always asked to finish once.
Final local scope closes on both normal and precondition/error paths, and receipt records exact shared-journal prefix bytes/SHA. Global later append does not change bound prefix.
Legacy launch/registry/observer paths retained; godot_local.py untouched; original renderer descendants retain discovered-only evidence semantics.
All declared v3 source dependencies are included in input liveSources.

findings: Sequence and block call setup_lifecycle before their first Git command; shared merge-base uses managed_run.
Parent and block register the same managed handle and obtain identity from its immutable ready lease.
Registry launch now carries declared stage to child environment; inherited local from_environment opens its own scope against the parent finite lease.
Both monitors use the same policy/native-path-derived coordination lock and source/policy/run journal; no v3 duplicate remember.
Block closes only its local scope; its parent finite WAIT belongs to the sequence. Block receipt binds prefix bytes; sequence finalization archives complete immutable journal including root close.
